stories.actor: A release operator responsible for staging integrity
stories.need: to deploy only scanned, signed, attested immutable images
stories.outcome: the running release is traceable to one reviewed source revision
stories.privacyBoundary: release evidence contains no credentials, sessions, private content, or exact coordinates
stories.rollback: retain and verify the immediately previous signed manifest before changing runtime state

criteria.text: All four images are scanned, signed, and carry SBOM and provenance attestations.
Deployment rejects an unsigned image, missing attestation, or untrusted repository prefix.
The runtime revision and exact digest manifest agree after deployment.
Rollback uses a previously retained manifest without rebuilding or down migration.
Protected GHCR/OIDC execution completes in the repository environment.

stories.actor: The primary on-call owner recovering staging after host loss
stories.need: an independently stored database and private-object snapshot that can be read back
stories.outcome: recovery does not depend on the failed staging host or undocumented knowledge
stories.privacyBoundary: backups remain encrypted, access-controlled, checksum-verified, and subject to approved deletion policy
stories.rollback: replication is append-only under a unique snapshot prefix and never deletes the source backup

criteria.text: The database archive and checksum validate before replication.
Private attachment bytes are snapshotted and verified byte-for-byte after readback.
A restore invalidates browser and OAuth sessions while preserving required durable state.
Failed or stale independent replication emits an actionable metric and alert.
An independently controlled destination and isolated restore target are supplied and exercised.

stories.actor: A participant creating and recovering a managed Patchwork identity
stories.need: signup, OAuth callback, session restoration, recovery, and logout to fail safely
stories.outcome: account access is usable without exposing credentials or allowing session replay
stories.privacyBoundary: OAuth payloads are encrypted server-side and browser state contains only opaque cookies and public identity
stories.rollback: failed identity operations leave no active browser session and expose a stable retry path

criteria.text: Managed signup rejects forged identity fields and unsafe upstream responses.
Callback success, denial, expiry, replay, malformed state, and URL sanitization are covered.
Session refresh, expiry, revocation, and deactivation remain durable and isolated.
English and Spanish recovery interfaces remain keyboard accessible.
Fresh live signup, recovery-email, credential rotation, and OAuth/PDS callback complete with disposable credentials.

stories.actor: Two authenticated participants coordinating aid through Patchwork
stories.need: the aid, offer, schedule, group, chat, report, close, and delete journey to work without fixtures
stories.outcome: the central collaboration workflow survives restarts and enforces current authorization
stories.privacyBoundary: public AT geography remains approximate and exact personal coordinates never enter durable server state
stories.rollback: partial external failures remain retryable and reconciliation cannot regress newer private state

criteria.text: Coordination scheduling is durable, idempotent, authorized, localized, and restart-safe.
Group and room access reflects current membership, roles, blocks, and moderation state.
Bounded chat enforces connection or membership authorization, retention, reporting, and redaction.
The browser journey covers success, denial, retry, empty, stale, and responsive states in both locales.
A fresh two-account PDS and Jetstream lifecycle completes on the protected deployed revision.

stories.actor: The primary on-call owner handling a staging incident
stories.need: alerts to be acknowledged, escalated, mitigated, and resolved through executable runbooks
stories.outcome: material failures cannot remain silently unattended or create unsafe writes
stories.privacyBoundary: alerts and incident evidence contain identifiers and counts but no private bodies, destinations, credentials, or coordinates
stories.rollback: the incident commander can enter maintenance mode or restore the retained immutable release

criteria.text: Material API, ingestion, moderation, backup, retention, and delivery failures have owned alerts.
Maintenance mode blocks unsafe writes while status and safe reads remain available.
The primary owner, severity model, acknowledgment objective, and decision authority are documented.
A timed game day records alert, acknowledgment, mitigation, recovery, and redacted evidence.
A distinct secondary responder accepts escalation and demonstrates access.

stories.actor: An English- or Spanish-speaking participant using assistive technology
stories.need: every production journey and failure state to remain understandable and operable
stories.outcome: language or access needs do not prevent safe participation or account control
stories.privacyBoundary: translated and accessible feedback never reveals another participant or private service detail
stories.rollback: a locale or accessibility regression blocks release promotion and retains the prior digest manifest

criteria.text: All production keys and rendered routes have English and Spanish parity.
Keyboard, focus, names, landmarks, errors, status announcements, and contrast pass local gates.
Routes reflow at 320px, remain usable at 200 percent text, and honor reduced motion.
Locale changes preserve URL, form, and recoverable workflow state.
Independent WCAG/assistive-technology and professional Spanish reviews have no launch blocker.

stories.actor: An operator protecting participants during a dependency failure
stories.need: the system to degrade safely and recover idempotently
stories.outcome: outages do not create unauthorized, duplicated, unmoderated, or unrecoverable state
stories.privacyBoundary: dependency errors use stable safe codes and never copy upstream bodies or protected data into logs
stories.rollback: unsafe submission paths remain disabled until audited recovery conditions are satisfied

criteria.text: Database, PDS, stream, object store, scanner, provider, and moderation failures fail closed where required.
Mutation retries are idempotent and stale or duplicate external events cannot regress state.
Logs, alerts, exports, and browser artifacts pass private-data absence and redaction gates.
A bounded staging soak records latency, errors, saturation, queues, restarts, and recovery.
Production traffic sizing and sustained operations are approved separately from the home-staging envelope.

stories.actor: The person making the protected-pilot go or no-go decision
stories.need: one revision-bound record of tests, artifacts, operations, approvals, limitations, and evidence expiry
stories.outcome: local success cannot be mistaken for an external approval or evidence from another release
stories.privacyBoundary: decision evidence is redacted and links to controlled records rather than copying sensitive inputs
stories.rollback: a failed or incomplete gate leaves public traffic disabled and the prior release available

criteria.text: The full verification baseline records counts, skips, failures, migrations, scans, and artifact redaction.
The evidence binds the Git revision, image digests, runtime labels, backup, and rollback manifest.
Every story criterion maps to automated, operational, or explicitly external evidence.
The decision is exactly GO, CONDITIONAL GO, or NO-GO with unresolved gates and owners.
Formal legal, privacy, security, accessibility, translation, and pilot authority are supplied by accountable reviewers.
